title: Count Distinct Elements in Every Window
description: Given an array of integers `nums` and a window size `k`, return the count of distinct elements in every window of size `k` as the window slides from left to right.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `k`. Second line contains `n` integers.
output_format: Space-separated distinct counts for each window.
hints: Use a frequency map for the first k elements.
Slide the window by decrementing the count of the leaving element and adding the new element.
Remove elements from the map when their count drops to 0 so `len(map)` gives distinct count.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+n]]
    from collections import defaultdict
    counts = defaultdict(int)
    for i in range(k):
        counts[nums[i]] += 1
    res = [str(len(counts))]
    for i in range(k, n):
        out_elem = nums[i - k]
        counts[out_elem] -= 1
        if counts[out_elem] == 0: del counts[out_elem]
        in_elem = nums[i]
        counts[in_elem] += 1
        res.append(str(len(counts)))
    print(' '.join(res))
